title: Veriflow: B2B Revenue Leakage & Invoice Auditing System
description: A production-oriented dual-model machine learning platform for enterprise financial compliance, comparing invoices against POs to detect price variances and flag shipping overcharges.

title: NEGO BOTS: AI-Driven Negotiation Simulator
description: An interactive web-based simulator where you can watch AI models battle over pricing, or test your haggling skills against a mathematically ruthless AI Seller powered by Reinforcement Learning (PPO).

title: RescueAI: AI Emergency Response Platform
description: RescueAI: A bilingual (English/Urdu) AI emergency response platform for Pakistan. Features instant GPS-SOS alerts, live responder tracking, and ARIA, a real-time AI assistant for critical emergency guidance via voice or text.

title: Genetron: 5G Tower Placement Optimizer
description: Genetron: A spatial AI and optimization platform that leverages multi-objective NSGA-II genetic algorithms and high-fidelity spectral modeling to determine mathematically optimal 5G base station placements in dense urban environments.

title: Terrag AI: AI-Powered Data Analytics Platform
description: Terrag AI: A Streamlit-based AI-powered data analytics app for intelligent insights from business datasets like customers, feedback, and sales data.

title: ThinkBoard: Data Analytics Dashboard
description: ThinkBoard: A Flask-based web application for uploading CSV files, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data with interactive charts, featuring a modern glassmorphism design and responsive layout.

title: Dishly: Modern Recipe Management System
description: Dishly: A modern recipe management system with pantry tracking, social features, and an admin panel, built with PHP, MySQL, and modern CSS for a responsive UI.

title: Filesystem Time Machine: File System Monitoring & OS Visualization
description: Filesystem Time Machine: A powerful file system monitoring and version control application with interactive OS concepts visualization, built with React and FastAPI.
